default-secret-keys.description: Armored secret keys for the default keyring

default-public-keys.description: All public keys in the default keyring, including third parties

fondo-secret-keys.description: Armored secret keys for the fondo keyring

fondo-public-keys.description: All public keys in the fondo keyring, including third parties

github-credentials.description: git-credential-store line for github.com, read during activation by brew bundle before home-manager exists

atuin-key.description: Atuin sync encryption key; no target because home-manager activation pipes it into `atuin login` on stdin, reading username/password from the same item

claude-sync-age-key.description: age identity encrypting claude-sync session backups; must be identical on every machine and is unrecoverable if lost. The same item's bucket/endpoint/access-key-id/secret-access-key fields are read by home-manager activation to render ~/.claude-sync/config.yaml

foundry-api-key.description: Microsoft Foundry API key for Claude Code on the work machine

foundry-resource.description: Microsoft Foundry resource name for Claude Code on the work machine

anthropic-api-key.description: Personal Anthropic API key for opencode and claude-api

openai-api-key.description: Personal OpenAI API key for opencode

typesafe-api-key.description: TypeSafe API key for the opencode auto-mode decision reviewer

telegram-opencode-bot-token.description: Telegram bot token for the opencode bot on irulan
